feature_additions.name: Servant of Winter
feature_additions.description: Gain the Nature sphere with the water package, or the corresponding package chosen for a variant Frostweaver; gain a +1 Nature caster-level bonus at 2nd level.

feature_additions.name: Frost Motes
feature_additions.description: Begin each day with frost motes equal to the casting ability modifier (minimum 1). Spend and regain them through Frostweaver sphere effects and ice charms.

feature_additions.name: Frost Mote Augmentation
feature_additions.description: Spend one frost mote while casting a sphere effect to add the appropriate elemental descriptor and enable one applicable spellrime.

feature_additions.name: Frost Familiar
feature_additions.description: While at least one frost mote remains, gain a familiar using Incanter level as Wizard level. A melted or slain familiar reforms through the Frostweaver recovery rules.

feature_additions.name: Blessings of Winter
feature_additions.description: Choose one blessing at 2nd level and every 4 levels thereafter.

feature_additions.name: Freeze Magic
feature_additions.description: Spend a frost mote to freeze an ongoing or newly created magical effect after a successful magic skill check.

feature_additions.name: Frozen
feature_additions.description: Gain the published Frostweaver capstone, including improved matching-descriptor caster level and doubled frost-mote recovery.
